content:
Emily R: Quick flag — weekly KPI snapshot shows webinar MQLs down 41% MoM after launch. Dashboard card 'Launch Overview' shows dip Thu-Fri. Anyone else seeing this?

Maria L: saw a dip too. Paid social CTR stable but 'request demo' conversion lower. Could be attribution or landing change. :thinking_face:

Josh P: We pushed a small CDN redirect last Friday for the A/B test. Might've stripped UTMs. Checking LB rules.

analytics-bot: Query: webinar_form_submit events: 2026-05-05: 398, 2026-05-12: 235. Cohort breakdown: paid_social down 52%.

Kevin S: Confirm rule in LB (#77): 

```
if path == '/lp/webinar' then redirect to /lp/webinar-b with 302
```

(not preserving querystring). Sorry, that was a mistake — rolling fix.

Maria L: If UTMs were dropped, ad platform reports clicks but GA won't attach leads -> leads look organic. Matches symptom.

Nina C: Recommend: (1) immediate fix to preserve querystring; (2) reingest last 10 days with click_id join and update dashboard attribution. Agree?

Josh P: Agree. I'll kick off reingest job and publish a delta table. ETA about 90m.

analytics-bot: Reingest complete: reconciled +139 MQLs back to paid_social for 2026-05-10..2026-05-12. 'Launch Overview' card updated. Note: retro attribution labeled 'reconciled' on row level.

Emily R: Great. Can we add a visible note on dashboard: "Attribution reconciled via event reingest on 2026-05-12" and suppress pager alerts for short-term retro fixes? :thumbsup:

Maria L: I'll add the note and change the weekly KPI alert window to 72h for launch cards. Also filing a postmortem entry in Launch Playbook.

Kevin S: Fix deployed — redirect now preserves querystring. Adding integration test to CI to prevent regressions.

Josh P: Closing loop: validated across eu/us regions, metrics look consistent now. Thanks team.

analytics-bot: Dashboard updated; alert thresholds changed.
